gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-tangsa: Warnes draws wire-bent letters of constant thickness, their ink strokes tapering out before they touch, spread wide with stretched tracking. Noto Sans Tangsa, a sans-serif with wide, inviting round letters, gives that loud heading somewhere friendly to land.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-tc: Loud, wiry and widely spaced, Warnes looks like bent wire laid out in letters, with every stroke the same thickness. Noto Sans TC, a sans-serif, softens it.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-telugu: Expressive and a little stencil-cut, Warnes holds one single stroke weight. Noto Sans Telugu, a sans with a high-set midline and counters that stay connected to the outside, takes over the quieter work, while Warnes earns its keep big and brief.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-thaana: Bold and unshaded, Warnes has none of the thick-thin swell a pointed brush would give, just ink strokes tapering out before they touch. Noto Sans Thaana, with its big open lowercase, can be sized generously.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-thai: Warnes looks like plain, unshaded lines, spread wide, with tapered ink strokes that stop short of touching. It is built to shout, while Noto Sans Thai, a plain sans with swollen, glass-bead lowercase and open round letters, is built to be read.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-thai-looped: Expressive and bold, Warnes keeps a single line weight across stretched, spacious letters whose ink strokes taper out before touching. Noto Sans Thai Looped, a sans with tall bodies, reads steadily and smoothly.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-tifinagh: Expressive and bold, Warnes holds one constant pen width through stretched, spacious letters with tapering ink strokes. Noto Sans Tifinagh, a plain sans with inflated, open bowls, is happy to be sized up.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-tirhuta: Warnes bends every curve as thick as its straight stems, with ink strokes that taper out before touching and generous, stretched spacing. Noto Sans Tirhuta, a plain sans with a dominant x-height and cut-back terminals, reads smooth and contemporary over a long passage.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-ugaritic: Expressive from the first letter, Warnes lays strokes like fine rope in stretched shapes, tapering before they touch. Noto Sans Ugaritic, a sans-serif with little gap between x-height and cap height, makes the pair feel boldly sturdy.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-vai: Warnes makes every diagonal as stout as every upright, with ink strokes that taper out before touching and stretched, spacious tracking. Noto Sans Vai, a sans-serif whose words read as solid blocks, supplies the strongest quality here: a loud top and a steady, modern base.
